item.title: 'Tears of joy': US Women's Hockey families reflect on golden journey
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey team won the Olympic gold medal Thursday in Milan after a comeback effort and an overtime victory. And many had family in the stands taking in the drama.

item.title: Kansas company gets $3 million to develop drones for farmers
item.description: The goal is to develop technology that can be used by farmers, ranchers and others to improve crop yields and cut costs.

item.title: KU's lack of three point shooting leads to Allen Fieldhouse blowout vs. Cincy
item.description: The #8 Kansas Jayhawks (20-7) were beaten by the Cincinnati Bearcats (15-12) at Allen Fieldhouse on Saturday, due in large part to the battle beyond the three-point line.

item.title: Jayhawks sweep Wildcats in Dillons Sunflower Showdown, 75-68
item.description: Led by four players in double figures, Kansas claimed the Dillons Sunflower Showdown sweep over Kansas State with a 75-68 win at Bramlage Coliseum on Saturday.

item.title: Storm Track 3 Forecast: Chilly weekend; fire weather concern returns next week
item.description: Temperatures stay cool and below average through the start of the week. Meteorologist Lucy Doll tracks the return of spring-like temperatures and fire weather concerns.

item.title: Hutchinson woman killed; suspect dies after police pursuit
item.description: A woman was fatally shot in Hutchinson on Friday night and the suspect later died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound after a pursuit with police.

item.title: One dead after single‑vehicle crash in northeast Wichita
item.description: It happened just before 1 a.m. in the 6800 block of East Winterberry Circle, near Woodlawm Boulevard and East 29th Street.

item.title: Longtime Wichita radio host, Greg “The Hitman” Williams, dies after battle with cancer
item.description: Friends of former Wichita radio DJ Greg “The Hitman” Williams announced Saturday that he died after a months‑long battle with stage‑four cancer.

item.title: Body found in northeast Wichita pond
item.description: Officers were dispatched to a small pond behind Trinity Academy, around 2:40 p.m. in the 1800 block of N. Garnett for a reported submersion.

item.title: One dead, two unhurt in Harvey County grain bin collapse
item.description: One person is dead, and two others escaped without injuries after a grain bin collapsed in southeast Newton on Saturday afternoon.
